title: Customs House, Brisbane
geometryBasis: The native twenty-point OSM outline locates the twin orthogonal wings, narrower central bay and curved northeast projection. The floor count and copper dome are corroborated by the current operator.
sectionBasis: Work from the Queen Street approach datum. There are two street-side floors and an exposed basement on the river side about 3.4 metres below it. The ribbed hemispherical roof reaches roughly the mapped 20 m height at the lantern.
limitations: The exterior follows the public-domain archival street view, mapped walls and written restoration record. Heights, window progression on less visible elevations, capitals and fine stone ornament are estimates.
The ongoing copper colour change after the 2024 replacement is represented by a muted transitional palette. Fine heritage inscriptions and exact railing ironwork are generalized.
Source Queensland Government terrain fixes the site slope. Landing and foundation positions are approximate. The adjoining river wall, precinct buildings and vegetation are outside scope.
